nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly well-tolerant, including one with a known vitamin C allergy who experienced no irritation, though a few report stinging, tingling or needing to cut back to once-daily use to avoid dryness.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 40s using it for early fine lines and thinning under-eye skin generally report smoother, more hydrated skin and visibly softer lines.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry-combination skin reports the serum irritated her eye area specifically in dry weather, without noticeably reducing her dark circles.

concerns.redness: Reactions range widely: most reviewers report no irritation at all, including some with sensitive skin or a vitamin C allergy, but a handful describe stinging, burning, or in one case severe redness and swelling that took over a week to resolve.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as rich and hydrating, keeping the under-eye area soft and moisturized without heaviness or greasiness; one reviewer felt it left her eyes feeling weighed down the morning after use.
concerns.spots: Reports on dark circles are split: many reviewers describe a clear brightening or fading after two to several weeks of consistent use, while a comparable number say they saw little to no change, particularly those whose dark circles come from thin, translucent under-eye skin rather than discoloration.
concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and crow's feet generally report smoother, softer-looking skin around the eyes within a few weeks; some say the effect on lines is more noticeable than any change in dark circles.

aspects.libelle: Peach or orange tint that can double as concealer
A few report inconsistent color or texture between bottles
Small amount needed, bottle lasts a long time
Pricey compared to regular eye creams
Product can harden or clog at the pump spout

extraits.texte: Purchased this to reduce dark circles and it did the total opposite after the first use. Skin was became very irritated and burned my skin off making it hard to even close my eyes. Skin irritated for 8 days and the only reason it started to heal was due to my esthetician. She provided me with treatment to help reduce the pain that I was in. Thank God I didn't have to go yo the doctor.

I have dry-combination skin and this irritated my eye area when the weather was dry. Didn't notice any changes besides the orange tint that the cream has covers up the dark circles slightly. The ingredients felt a bit too strong for my eye area.

I was so excited to try this product! I used it for a few days and it felt nice. However, I'm not sure if it was a coincidence or a reaction to the product but.....one night i went to bed and kept waking up because my left eye was hurting me on my lid and underneath my eye. I didnt see anything but when I touched it with the slightest bit of pressure, it was painful. Like the feeling you get when you have a black and blue and touch it. by the time i woke up in the morning, my lid was completely swollen, i had bumps in the corner on my skin (closest to my temple) and under my eye was swollen. Looked like someone punch me in the face and my eye ws half way closed. So, I dont know if something got in my eye or it was from the cream because my right eye was fine. I may have to try it again in a few weeks and if the same thing happens, i will know for sure it was from the product. However, right now, I cannot be certain but..my eye was fine before i started using this product and it was only after 3-4 days that this happened. so, I cannot recommend.

extraits.titre: I am really impressed after trying this eye cream
extraits.texte: I suffer from dark under eye circles and was rather impressed after trying this eye cream. In the short amount of time that I have been using this, I have seen rapid results. The vitamin c truly helps to lighten dark circles as well as de puff and hydrate the eye area. After using this product not only do I see a decrease in dark circles but my eye area feels real good and fine lines and wrinkles have been smoothed out. This is a product I would highly recommend to anyone who wants to diminish dark circles and add hydration to the eye area.

I was initially hesitant to try Kiehl's Vitamin C Eye Serum because I have a known allergy to Vitamin C, and the skin around my eyes is particularly sensitive. However, I decided to give it a shot, and I'm so glad I did! This serum is incredibly emollient and feels luxuriously moisturizing on the skin. It absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue, and my under-eye area feels soft and hydrated all day. To my surprise, I experienced no irritation at all, which is a rarity for me with Vitamin C products. It's been a game-changer in my skincare routine, helping to smooth fine lines and brighten my eyes without any of the discomfort I usually associate with active ingredients like Vitamin C. If you have sensitive skin or are wary of trying Vitamin C products, this one is definitely worth considering!

I received Kiehl's Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum in exchange for my honest review. This eye serum has a creamy consistency that absorbs easily and plays well with makeup. I love that it's in a pump so you're not digging your fingers into a tub. I have noticed an instant smoothing effect in the under eye area when I apply this product. I'm in my 40s, and the skin around my eyes is showing signs of age. This serum moisturizes, softens and evens out the texture. I definitely recommend!
